story.title: Migrant Boat Capsizes Off Senegal, Resulting in Fatalities and Missing Persons
story.summary: A migrant boat capsized off the coast of Senegal while attempting to reach Spain, leading to at least one confirmed death and dozens reported missing. This incident is part of a larger trend, with over 11,000 migrants arriving in the Canary Islands in the first two weeks of November, prompting local authorities to enhance their health services in response to the influx.

timeline_highlights.title: Tragic Capsizing of Migrant Boat off Djibouti Leaves 139 Dead and 84 Missing
timeline_highlights.summary: A migrant boat capsized off the coast of Djibouti, resulting in at least 139 confirmed deaths, including 15 children. The International Organization for Migration reported that 84 individuals remain missing, while 82 survivors, all Ethiopian nationals, have been accounted for. The vessel was reportedly carrying over 300 people en route to Yemen when the incident occurred.

timeline_highlights.title: Migrant Boat Capsizes Off Senegal, Leaving at Least 21 Dead
timeline_highlights.summary: A small boat carrying migrants sank off the coast of northwestern Senegal, resulting in at least 21 fatalities. The Senegalese Interior Ministry confirmed that one person was rescued, and search operations are ongoing to locate any additional survivors. This incident highlights the ongoing dangers faced by migrants attempting to reach Europe via perilous sea routes.
key_facts: At least 21 people have died after a migrant boat sank off the coast of Senegal.
One person has been rescued, and search operations are continuing.
The incident occurred near Kebemer, northwestern Senegal.
